title: 苹果重组聚焦AI，裁员波及三大团队
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I mean, both Mark Gurman who leads our coverage of Apple broke this story Friday, but I want to recap here.
segments.zh: 负责苹果报道的马克·古尔曼周五爆出这个消息，我在这里简单回顾一下。

segments.en: This is just reprioritizing right, Mark. What are the details of the report you put out?
segments.zh: 这只是在重新调整优先级，马克。你报道的细节是什么？

segments.en: Yeah, so Apple's cutting jobs in three central areas. One team is the Vision Pro team, so the group called VPG responsible for the headset. The second is Siri. In the third is a team
segments.zh: 苹果在三个核心领域裁员。一个是Vision Pro团队，即负责头显的VPG小组。第二个是Siri。第三个是智能系统体验团队。

segments.en: called Intelligent Systems Experiences, which really comes down to integrating AI features through the operating system and services. So let me start with the Vision Pro. This is more
segments.zh: 这个团队主要负责将AI功能整合到操作系统和服务中。先从Vision Pro说起，这更像传统意义上的裁员。

segments.en: of your traditional layoff where they're cutting teams and scaling back things in this particular area. So they had a team working on gaming initiatives for the Vision Pro. That team has been
segments.zh: 他们削减了该领域的团队和业务。原本为Vision Pro开发游戏的团队已被完全解散并裁撤。

segments.en: completely dismantled and laid off. The second is their immersive video group. This is the team making virtual reality videos for the Vision Pro, one of the top selling points. They're scaling
segments.zh: 第二个是沉浸式视频团队，负责制作Vision Pro的虚拟现实视频，这是主要卖点之一。他们正在缩减规模。

segments.en: that back. They're cutting jobs there. They're cutting investments there, and they are going to drastically reduce the number of videos they produce in-house for the Vision Pro, instead pushing
segments.zh: 他们在该领域裁员并削减**，大幅减少内部制作的Vision Pro视频数量，转而外包给第三方。

segments.en: that off to third parties. For Siri and the Intelligent Systems Experience team, that's part of the software engineering organization. They're cutting jobs there as well to open up roles for people
segments.zh: 对于Siri和智能系统体验团队，属于软件工程部门，他们也在裁员，为能从事Siri AI新基础设施的人员腾出岗位。

segments.en: who can work on the new underlying infrastructure for Siri AI. So looking to develop faster, looking to bring in talent that is more specific towards that new infrastructure for that new
segments.zh: 目的是加快开发，引进更专注于新基础设施的人才，以支持新的语音助手和升级版Apple Intelligence。

segments.en: voice assistant and their upgraded Apple Intelligence, which launches this fall for the first time.
segments.zh: 该功能将于今年秋季首次推出。
